items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 08 November 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Shallow low pressure is centred in the North Sea. A deep low remains to the southwest of the British Isles over the next few days.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, settling easterly 3 or 4 tomorrow morning, increasing occasionally 5 in the south of the area tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, becoming fair tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Easterly 4 or 5, occasionally 6 overnight into Tuesday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
